affinity.notes: Disease-like markings are secondary to a physical flesh body and do not become dominant elemental construction.

anatomy.notes: The right hand and attached or held mass are ambiguous, while the left arm merges into the body.

archetype.notes: Slow melee brute does not communicate the intended mutation-choice controller duty.

counterplay.notes: The obscured hand or weapon mass prevents a clear read of attack direction, windup, or vulnerability.

finish.notes: Muddy limb edges and low material separation weaken readability.

framing.notes: Full lumbering silhouette is visible at a useful scale.

identity.notes: Diseased troll with visible misgrowth identifies the Mutant Troll form.

tier.notes: Blind reviewer perceived T2, not exact intended tier T3.
